_published_faq.name: How do I add StubHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add StubHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://open-ai-app.stubhub.net/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is StubHub MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, StubHub scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the StubHub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: StubHub provides these MCP tools: event_search, fetch_listings, and highlight_listing.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to StubHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to StubHub in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
StubHub does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is StubHub failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: StubHub scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
